preconditions.description: N is a positive integer representing the matrix dimension.
There are exactly N pairs of L and R values provided.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= L[i] <= R[i] <= N for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: For every row i, the range [L[i], R[i]] is valid within the matrix columns 1 to N.
Q is a non-negative integer representing the number of queries.

preconditions.expression: len(queries) == Q and all(1 <= x <= N and 1 <= y <= N for x, y in queries)
preconditions.description: There are exactly Q queries, and each query (x, y) refers to valid row and column indices.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly Q lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(line in ['E', 'O'] for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'E' (even) or 'O' (odd).

postconditions.expression: all((sum(1 for j in range(1, N+1) if j != y and L[i-1] <= j <= R[i-1]) for i in range(1, N+1) if i != x) % 2 == (0 if stdout_lines[k] == 'E' else 1) for k, (x, y) in enumerate(queries))
postconditions.description: For each query k with row x and column y, the output character correctly reflects the parity of the sum of the remaining matrix elements after removing row x and column y.
